consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : Tom is (tall) than Ben.
exercices.reponse: Tom is taller than Ben.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : This book is (interesting) than that one.
corrige: This book is **more interesting than** that one.
exercices.reponse: This book is more interesting than that one.

exercices.enonce: Donne le comparatif de : big, easy, fast, nice.
exercices.reponse: bigger, easier, faster, nicer

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : She is (tall) in the class.
corrige: She is **the tallest** in the class.
exercices.reponse: She is the tallest in the class.

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : It is (expensive) car.
exercices.reponse: It is the most expensive car.

exercices.enonce: Donne comparatif et superlatif de : good, bad.
exercices.reponse: good : better / the best ; bad : worse / the worst

exercices.enonce: Corrige : This house is more bigger than mine.
corrige: On ne cumule pas more et -er.
exercices.reponse: This house is bigger than mine.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Anna est aussi grande que Tom. »
exercices.reponse: Anna is as tall as Tom.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : She is tallest in the class.
corrige: She is **the tallest** in the class.
exercices.reponse: She is the tallest in the class.

exercices.enonce: Compare deux objets avec un comparatif, puis désigne le meilleur avec un superlatif.
corrige: Exemple : My phone is **newer than** yours. It is **the best** phone.
exercices.reponse: Exemple : My phone is newer than yours. It is the best phone.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : My dog is (small) than your dog.
corrige: *small* est un adjectif court (1 syllabe) : adjectif + -er + than.
exercices.reponse: My dog is smaller than your dog.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : A plane is (fast) than a car.
corrige: *fast* est court : fast → faster, suivi de *than*.
exercices.reponse: A plane is faster than a car.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : Maths is (difficult) than music for me.
corrige: *difficult* est long (3 syllabes) : more + adjectif + than.
exercices.reponse: Maths is more difficult than music for me.

exercices.enonce: Court ou long ? Classe ces adjectifs : cheap, beautiful, old, dangerous.
exercices.reponse: courts : cheap, old ; longs : beautiful, dangerous

exercices.enonce: Donne le comparatif de : hot, thin, sad.
corrige: Ces adjectifs finissent par voyelle + consonne : on double la consonne finale.
hot → hotter ; thin → thinner ; sad → sadder.
exercices.reponse: hotter, thinner, sadder

exercices.enonce: Donne le comparatif de : happy, heavy, funny.
corrige: Ces adjectifs finissent par -y : y → ier.
happy → happier ; heavy → heavier ; funny → funnier.
exercices.reponse: happier, heavier, funnier

exercices.enonce: Donne le comparatif de : large, safe, wide.
corrige: Ces adjectifs finissent déjà par -e : on ajoute juste -r.
large → larger ; safe → safer ; wide → wider.
exercices.reponse: larger, safer, wider

exercices.enonce: Donne le superlatif de : big, easy, nice.
corrige: big → the biggest (consonne doublée) ; easy → the easiest (y → iest) ; nice → the nicest (juste -st).
exercices.reponse: the biggest, the easiest, the nicest

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : My grandfather is (old) than my grandmother.
corrige: *old* est court : old → older, suivi de *than*.
exercices.reponse: My grandfather is older than my grandmother.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : This dress is (expensive) than that skirt.
exercices.reponse: This dress is more expensive than that skirt.

exercices.enonce: Mets au comparatif : Football is (popular) than rugby in my school.
corrige: *popular* est long (3 syllabes) : more popular than.
exercices.reponse: Football is more popular than rugby in my school.

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : The Nile is one of (long) rivers in the world.
exercices.reponse: The Nile is one of the longest rivers in the world.

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : Mount Everest is (high) mountain in the world.
corrige: C'est vrai : l'Everest est la plus haute montagne du monde.
exercices.reponse: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : This is (beautiful) beach in the region.
exercices.reponse: This is the most beautiful beach in the region.

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : For me, history is (interesting) subject.
exercices.reponse: For me, history is the most interesting subject.

exercices.enonce: Mets au superlatif : July is often (hot) month of the year in France.
corrige: *hot* est court, avec doublement de la consonne : the hottest.
exercices.reponse: July is often the hottest month of the year in France.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec le comparatif de *good* : Your idea is ___ than my idea.
exercices.reponse: Your idea is better than my idea.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec le superlatif de *bad* : This is ___ film of the year!
exercices.reponse: This is the worst film of the year!

exercices.enonce: Complète avec le comparatif de *far* : The library is ___ than the park.
corrige: *far* est irrégulier : *farther* ou *further* (les deux sont corrects).
exercices.reponse: The library is farther than the park. (ou further)

exercices.enonce: Complète avec le superlatif de *good* : She is ___ player in the team.
exercices.reponse: She is the best player in the team.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec as... as : My bag is (heavy) your bag. (aussi lourd que)
exercices.reponse: My bag is as heavy as your bag.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Ce jeu est aussi intéressant que ce livre. »
corrige: « aussi... que » = *as... as* ; l'adjectif ne change pas, même s'il est long.
This game is as interesting as this book.
exercices.reponse: This game is as interesting as this book. (ou as that book)

exercices.enonce: Corrige : Paul is more tall than Léa.
corrige: *tall* est court : on dit *taller*, pas *more tall*.
exercices.reponse: Paul is taller than Léa.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : My cat is gooder than your cat.
exercices.reponse: My cat is better than your cat.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : This exercise is easier that the first one.
corrige: Le comparatif se construit avec *than*, pas *that*.
exercices.reponse: This exercise is easier than the first one.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : It is the most fast car in the shop.
corrige: *fast* est court : superlatif *the fastest*, pas *the most fast*.
exercices.reponse: It is the fastest car in the shop.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : Today is badder than yesterday.
exercices.reponse: Today is worse than yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : Emma is the more intelligent girl in the class.
corrige: Au superlatif d'un adjectif long, on dit *the most*, pas *the more*.
exercices.reponse: Emma is the most intelligent girl in the class.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Mon frère est plus jeune que moi. »
exercices.reponse: My brother is younger than me.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « C'est le livre le plus intéressant de la bibliothèque. »
exercices.reponse: It's the most interesting book in the library.

exercices.enonce: Traduis en français : *An elephant is heavier than a horse, but a blue whale is the heaviest animal.*
corrige: *heavier than* = plus lourd que ; *the heaviest* = le plus lourd.
exercices.reponse: Un éléphant est plus lourd qu'un cheval, mais la baleine bleue est l'animal le plus lourd.

exercices.enonce: Traduis : « Le chocolat est meilleur que les bonbons. »
exercices.reponse: Chocolate is better than sweets. (ou than candy)

exercices.enonce: Comparatif ou superlatif ? « She is the youngest in her family. » Justifie.
corrige: Il y a *the* + adjectif + -est : c'est un superlatif.
On désigne la plus jeune de toute la famille.
exercices.reponse: superlatif (the + young + -est)

exercices.enonce: Comparatif ou superlatif ? « Cats are more independent than dogs. » Justifie.
corrige: On compare deux éléments avec *more* + adjectif + *than* : c'est un comparatif.
exercices.reponse: comparatif (more + adjectif long + than)

exercices.enonce: Lis : « Sam is 1.50 m tall. Lucy is 1.45 m. Max is 1.60 m. » Complète : Max is ___ (tall) of the three. Sam is ___ (tall) than Lucy.
corrige: Max est le plus grand des trois : superlatif *the tallest*.
Sam (1,50 m) est plus grand que Lucy (1,45 m) : comparatif *taller*.
exercices.reponse: Max is the tallest of the three. Sam is taller than Lucy.

exercices.enonce: Lis : « The red T-shirt costs 10 euros. The blue T-shirt costs 15 euros. The green T-shirt costs 15 euros too. » Complète : The blue T-shirt is ___ (expensive) the green T-shirt. The red T-shirt is ___ (cheap) of the three.
corrige: Le bleu et le vert coûtent le même prix : égalité *as expensive as*.
Le rouge est le moins cher : superlatif de *cheap* = *the cheapest*.
exercices.reponse: The blue T-shirt is as expensive as the green T-shirt. The red T-shirt is the cheapest of the three.

exercices.enonce: Lis : « In my family, Dad is 42, Mum is 40 and Grandpa is 70. » Écris deux phrases : compare l'âge de papa et de maman, puis dis qui est le plus âgé.
corrige: Papa (42 ans) est plus âgé que maman (40 ans) : *older than*.
Papi (70 ans) est le plus âgé : *the oldest*.
exercices.reponse: Dad is older than Mum. Grandpa is the oldest.

exercices.enonce: Compare deux animaux avec un adjectif long au comparatif.
corrige: Exemple de réponse : *A shark is more dangerous than a dolphin.*
exercices.reponse: Exemple : A shark is more dangerous than a dolphin.

exercices.enonce: Écris une phrase avec *as... as* pour dire que deux de tes amis sont aussi drôles l'un que l'autre.
corrige: Exemple de réponse : *Tom is as funny as Hugo.*
exercices.reponse: Exemple : Tom is as funny as Hugo.

exercices.enonce: Donne ton avis : quelle est la meilleure saison selon toi ? Réponds par une phrase avec un superlatif irrégulier.
corrige: Exemple de réponse : *For me, summer is the best season.*
exercices.reponse: Exemple : For me, summer is the best season.
